title: RFC 6962: Certificate Transparency (Experimental)
relevance: Defines append-only Merkle Tree logs, SCTs, STHs, inclusion and consistency proofs — underpins ciphertext-hash provenance logging for SYM-2P.

title: RFC 9162: Certificate Transparency Version 2.0 (obsoletes 6962)
relevance: Successor to RFC 6962; adds algorithm agility and explicit gossip requirements — informs the witness/monitor model for SYM-2P provenance.

title: Sigstore Rekor — Software Supply Chain Transparency Log
relevance: Production transparency log; Fulcio-style OIDC-bound ephemeral certs inform SYM-2P human identity model.

title: RFC 9420: The Messaging Layer Security (MLS) Protocol
relevance: Only IETF standard for E2EE group messaging (TreeKEM, forward secrecy, post-compromise security); candidate wire protocol for SYM-2P Stage 2.

title: RFC 9901: Selective Disclosure for JSON Web Tokens (SD-JWT)
relevance: Final standard for hash-based selective disclosure of JWT claims with Holder Binding — mandatory mechanism for SYM-2P credential layer.

title: W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model 2.0
relevance: Data model for credentials that SD-JWT VCs carry; anchors the selective disclosure + identity layer for SYM-2P.

title: W3C Decentralized Identifiers (DIDs) v1.0
relevance: did:web / did:key identifiers and DID Documents for self-sovereign agent identity — primary identity mechanism for SYM-2P agents.

title: OpenID Connect Discovery 1.0
relevance: Federated identity and JWKS discovery; underpins Fulcio-style ephemeral certs for human operators bridging to SYM-2P.

title: CloudEvents v1.0
relevance: Standard envelope for SYM-2P events (specversion, type, source, id, time, data) — the mandatory outer envelope for all SYM-2P provenance events.

title: W3C ActivityPub Recommendation
relevance: Actor-model federation (outbox/inbox) — candidate if SYM-2P needs cross-org follow/subscribe in a future extension.
